power.method: 18650 Li-Ion rechargeable battery (~2600 mAh; 2 included, holds up to 4)

features: wire-free 18650 battery power (up to 6 months on 2 / 1 year on 4 batteries)
PIR human detection with facial capture (up to 90% fewer false alerts)
40 ft (12 m) IR night vision, color by day
add-on camera — requires a Night Owl WNIP2-series Wi-Fi NVR (not standalone)
release_notes: The Night Owl CAM-BWNIP2LBU is a wire-free 1080p battery spotlight camera (18650 Li-Ion, up to 1 year) with a motion-activated white spotlight, PIR human detection, and two-way audio. It is an add-on camera for the Night Owl WNIP2-series Wi-Fi NVR. Specs from the official Night Owl product page.

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).
